decision.selectedAction: Complete the previously unexecuted empty-composer menu observation without interacting with model or reasoning controls.
decision.supervisorCorrection: Exact model and reasoning-mode verification is not a prerequisite for an empty-composer diagnostic that submits no model request. Requiring it here unnecessarily blocked collection of the requested UI evidence.
decision.limitedSupersession: Remove only that diagnostic precondition. Model and mode requirements for any later synthetic execution remain unchanged.

runtimeAdmission.sourceBinding: Capture this response's actual message ID and exact-body SHA-256 and bind the new admission to them and this directiveId.
runtimeAdmission.failureAction: Stop controlled work if the response is unavailable, malformed, denied, expired, or mismatched.

permittedChanges: Remove the model-control prerequisite from this diagnostic's orchestration only.
Use a precompiled, self-contained JavaScript source string for the existing read-only projection if that is the installed client's explicitly supported invocation form.
Add focused tests and append-only operational receipts for these narrow changes.
implementationBoundary.preparationRule: Prepare and hash the exact plain-JavaScript projection offline using existing repository tooling. Invoke it only through a documented installed-client interface. Do not use eval, Function constructors, or another dynamic-compilation mechanism inside the restricted runtime, or weaken its restrictions.
implementationBoundary.projectionSemantics: Preserve existing empty-context guards, current-state evidence requirements, bounded associations, withheld unclassified labels, and excluded-element filters.
implementationBoundary.groundedCounts: Supply only counts observed in the current diagnostic sample. Never insert zero or a visibility/enabled value merely to satisfy a guard.
implementationBoundary.unknownClientOrSourceDrift: Return the exact contract or source difference before live interaction; do not silently substitute.
implementationBoundary.verification: Run focused tests and applicable repository verification under Node v24.18.0 for changed code. Do not rerun unchanged gates merely to restate their earlier results.
implementationBoundary.githubPersistence: Commit only non-sensitive reusable orchestration, tests, directive, and checkpoint records under existing conventions. Keep detailed evidence private.

liveObservation.modelAndReasoningLabels: Optional read-only metadata when already visible; otherwise null with an availability reason.
liveObservation.tabRule: Use the empty task-owned tab when safe. Otherwise open at most one dedicated empty tab without altering the Project Manager tab or an unrelated draft.
requiredPreconditions: Fresh runtime admission and private evidence identity checks pass.
The authorized origin, profile, account continuity, and task tab are established.
Current message count, attachment count, and composer length are observed as zero.
No unresolved task chooser operation or blocking dialog is observed.
The reviewed projection has a supported invocation form without relaxing runtime restrictions.
steps: Collect one bounded pre-interaction sample using the reviewed projection and fresh count metadata.

If the sample establishes exactly one visible, enabled composer control with in-page menu semantics, invoke that specific observed control once. Otherwise return its unavailable or ambiguous state without clicking.
Collect up to two bounded post-interaction samples. Do not reopen the menu, wait for a presumed upload-item label, fill the composer, or touch model controls.
Record actual allowed menu metadata and unavailable fields. Do not activate an item.
If necessary, close only this diagnostic's positively identified in-page menu through one supported targeted action.
Preserve the observation receipt and return it. Do not proceed to a file chooser or synthetic request.
liveObservation.locatorRule: Use the control identity established by the current safe projection. No forced clicks, speculative label variants, or broad text searches.
liveObservation.privacyScope: Empty composer and its explicitly associated menu only; no scripts, application state, history, account menus, document suggestions, or unrelated content.

attemptCeiling.ifAnAdditionalPriorMenuOpeningIsDiscover: Stop because the reported unused diagnostic allowance is no longer established.

stopConditions: Admission, evidence identity, or installed-contract validation fails.
Safe empty-context verification or supported projection execution is unavailable.
The observed menu control is missing, ambiguous, disabled, or not demonstrably an in-page menu control.
A browser operation fails, times out, or becomes ambiguous.
A new permission, account change, restricted-runtime bypass, or unrelated-content access would be required.
The authorized observations and return are complete.

failureHandling.preInteractionFailure: Preserve the failed sample and close this corrected diagnostic as blocked. Do not add another prerequisite-recovery loop.
failureHandling.interactionFailure: Do not repeat the click. Use at most one remaining permitted read-only sample if responsive, then return.
failureHandling.unexpectedNativePicker: Do not assign a file. Stop and preserve the event; cancel only through supported controls positively identifying this diagnostic's own empty picker.
failureHandling.unknownMetadata: Retain null and its reason rather than treating missing observations as false or zero.
failureHandling.successfulMenuObservation: Return evidence only. It does not restore probe or upload authorization.

required: Actual directive source identity and fresh runtime-admission receipt.
Actual execution HEAD and narrow code/test changes, if any.
Private evidence and fixture-manifest identity checks.
Installed-client contract identity and exact projection-source hash.
Available pre-interaction and post-interaction samples with timestamps.
Exact operation order, counts, errors, and explicit unavailable fields.
Confirmation of zero model-control interaction, chooser activity, uploads, prompts, and probe submissions.
Confirmation that historical artifacts, fixtures, settings, and unrelated drafts remain unchanged.
Private receipt hash and destination persistence evidence or exact routing blocker.
completionEvidence.returnFormat: One syntactically valid operational JSON object generated by the existing JSON serializer; no Markdown transformations, arbitrary backslash insertion, raw content, or worker-authored diagnosis.

exactDestination.submissionAmbiguity: Check destination metadata without resending; preserve unresolved delivery rather than repeatedly clicking Send.
